english:
Wednesday. Feast of the Church. Tone 3 [g3]: "Rejoice, O Holy Church" (Urakh ler surb yegeghetsi).
Canticle [Harts] Tone 3: "Today resplendent" (Aysor paytsar), with its canon [sarokn].
Morning Song: "Holiness is fitting to Your house" (Tan kum vayel e). Litany: "Let us say" (Asasguk).
Patronymic [Mankunk]: Of the Cross, from the tone of the day. Then: "By the Holy Church" (Surb yegeghetsyavs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "At the door of this holy temple" (Ar dran surb tajaris).

Midday Liturgy
Introit: "For peace" (Zkhaghaghutyun).
Response [Phokh]: "The Lord reigns" (Ter thag).
Hymn Tone 3 [g3]: "Today rejoicing" (Aysor urakhatsyal).
Psalm 147: "Praise Jerusalem."
Prophet Zephaniah 3:14 "Rejoice greatly" to verse 18 "your afflicted".
Epistle: Hebrews 9:11 "But Christ being come" to verse 15 "eternal".
Alleluia: "The Lord is in His holy temple."
Gospel: Matthew 16:13 "And when Jesus came" to verse 12 [actually 16:19/20 or similar, reflecting "loosed in heaven"].

In the Evening
Messedi: "Bless the Lord here" (Ast orhnetsek), "Who stand" (O kayq).
Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [bk]: "Ineffable" (Anpatumn). Litany: "By the Holy Church" (Surb yegeghetsyavs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "In the midst of this temple" (I mej tajaris).

Thursday. Feast of the Church. Tone 2 [bk]: "Ineffable" (Anpatumn) and "He who is co-essential" (Or hamagoyd), which is of the Resurrection; find and recite it. Canticle [Harts]: Say that of the Ark, Tone 3 [g3]: "Today they rejoice" (Aysor tsndan), with its canon [sarokn].
Song: "Holiness is fitting to Your house" (Tan kum vayel e). Litany: "Let us say" (Asasguk).
Patronymic [Mankunk]: Of the Cross, from the tone of the day. Then: "By the Holy Church" (Surb yegeghetsyavs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "At the door of this holy temple" (Ar dran surb tajaris).

Midday Liturgy
Introit: "For peace" (Zkhagha).
Response [Phokh]: "The Lord reigns" (Ter thag).
Hymn Tone 3 [g3]: "Today they rejoice" (Aysor tsndan).
Psalm 86 [87]: "His foundations."
Prophet Isaiah 2:1 "And it shall come to pass in the days" to verse 6 "the house of Jacob".
Epistle: Hebrews 12:18 "For you are not come" to verse 27 "that those things which cannot be shaken may remain".
Alleluia: "How beloved are."
Gospel: Matthew 21:12 "And Jesus entered" to verse 17 "and lodged there".

In the Evening
Messedi: "Bless the Lord here" (Ast orhne), "Who stand" (O kayq).
Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [by / bd]: "Incorruptible" (Anapakan). Litany: "By the Holy Church" (Surb yegeghetsyavs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "In the midst of this temple" (I mej tajaris).

Friday. Feast of the Cross. Tone 2 [b3]: "Incorruptible is the holy Cross" (Anapakan surb zkhachn), with its canon [sarokn]. Magnificat [Mets]: "Mother of Light" (Mayr lusoy).
Song: "You have given a banner" (Etur yerkyugha). Litany: "Let us say" (Asasguk).
Patronymic [Mankunk]: Of the Cross, from the tone of the day. Then: "By Your Holy Cross" (Surb khachivs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "Protect [us]" (Pahpanea).

Midday Liturgy
Introit: "Before the honorable" (Araji patuakan).
Response [Phokh]: "The Lord has reigned" (Ter tagavoryats).
Hymn Tone 4 [gk]: "O four-winged" (Ov qarathev).
Psalm 97 [98]: "All have seen."
Prophet Zechariah 14:5 "And he shall come" to verse 11 "in Jerusalem with hope".
Epistle: Philippians 2:5 "Let this mind be in you" to verse 11 "to the glory of God the Father".
Alleluia: "You have given a banner to those who fear You."
Gospel: John 19:10 "Then he delivered Him" to verse 22 "I have written".

In the Evening
Messedi: "You have given a banner" (Etur yerkyughads), "As they were saved" (Orpes prketsan).
Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [g3]: "Who didst dawn" (Or dzagetsyer).
Litany: "By Your Holy Cross" (Surb khachivs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "Protect [us]" (Pahpanea).

Saturday. Feast of the Cross. Tone 3 [g3]: "Who didst dawn" (Or dzagetsyer), with its canon [sarokn]. Magnificat [Mets]: "Splendid Mother of God" (Astvatsatsin paytsar). Song: "You have given a banner" (Etur yerkyugha). Litany: "Let us say" (Asasguk).
Patronymic [Mankunk] of the step [steghi], Tone 4 [dz]: "Encompassed" (Parunakyal). Then: "By Your Holy Cross" (Surb khachivs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "Protect [us]" (Pahpanea).

Midday Liturgy
Introit: "Before the honorable" (Araji patuakan).
Response [Phokh]: "The Lord has reigned" (Ter tagavoryats).
Hymn Tone 4 [gk]: "Your Holy Cross" (Surb zkhach ko).
Psalm 97 [98]: "They shall declare."
Prophet Isaiah 51:4 "Hearken unto me" to [51]:11 "and sighing".
Epistle: 1 Timothy 6:13 "I charge thee" to verse 16 "forever, amen".
Alleluia: "As they were saved."
Gospel: John 7:37 "In the last day" to verse 52 "does not arise".

In the Evening
"Joyful Light" (Luys zvart).
Messedi: "You have given a banner to those who fear You" (Etur yerkyughadsats).
Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [gd]: "Today appearing" (Aysor yerevumn).
Litany: "By Your Holy Cross" (Surb khachivs), "Save [us]" (Ketso). Prayer: "Protect [us]" (Pahpanea).

***

From here until the tenth Sunday, look here for the feasts and the Sunday Canticles [Harts]. But for the Canticles of the Martyrs and of fasting, and the resurrectional Hymns [Hambartsi], the Tones, the months, and the length of the intervening period, always look in the Calendar [Taregirk].

Second Sunday after the Holy Cross.
Tone of the Resurrection.
Canticle [Harts] Tone 3 [g3]: "Who came by the will of the Father" (Or yegir kamav hor).
Magnificat [Mets]: "Cherubimic Throne" (Athor qrovbeakan).

Midday Liturgy
Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to You."
Prophet Isaiah 14:3 "And it shall come to pass in the day" to verse 17 "their cities".
Epistle: 2 Corinthians 10:18 "Brethren, for not he..." to 11:10 "the truth of Christ".
Alleluia: Of the tone of the day.
Gospel: Mark 10:1 "And..."
